answer_1.quote: The explosion of information has expedited the rapid development of text summarization technology, which can help us to grasp the key points from miscellaneous information quickly.

answer_2.quote: We adopt ROUGE (RG) F 1 score as the evaluation metric.

answer_4.quote: We conduct human evaluations to measure the quantify of the summaries for importance and readability. We randomly selected 100 samples from the Gigaword test set. The annotators are required to give a comparison between two model summaries that are presented anonymously.
answer_4.guideline: The annotators are required to give a comparison between two model summaries that are presented anonymously.
